name: Firewall
author: alexander
description: ArchAlarm '99 — a real nftables-backed inbound firewall with a ZoneAlarm/BlackICE-era monitor panel: live blocked-connection feed with reverse-DNS and one-click ban, a stealth/reject response mode, threat meter, and one-click on/off.

barWidget.description: Toggle ArchAlarm '99 and watch it work: blocked connections with hostnames, one-click ban, stealth/reject mode, and a threat meter in a retro green-on-black panel.
